//: N4: the one firearm in the mod.  The công an of a phường in 2004 did not patrol armed in the ordinary way - a beat policeman carried a trọng (club) and a whistle - but the district offices and the border units did hold service pistols, and a good many công an bought one.  This is the pattern the northern arsenals had been building since the 1960s: a blowback-operated double-action-only 9x18mm pistol, all steel, fixed barrel, brown bakelite grips.  Every part of it is described rather than named, because the content bible's rule is no trademarks; the 9x18mm cartridge and the mechanism are common knowledge, the maker's name is not ours to print.
description: A service pistol in the 9x18mm cartridge, the pattern the district offices carried for thirty years.  The slide and frame are blued steel, the grips brown bakelite, and there is no safety to fumble with: the hammer simply falls when the trigger is pulled, so the shot goes where the muzzle points.  Eight rounds in the magazine.  The sling loop at the base of the grip is worn smooth and the finish is gone thin at the muzzle.
